Toddler meals

Red lentil soup

Vöröslencse krémleves

6 months+ Sound idea 35 min 4 portions

Serve warm in a bowl. Freeze without the yogurt, and add that spoon after thawing if you use it.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g Red lentils (Rinsed)
  • 1 medium Carrot (Peeled and chopped)
  • 1 medium Tomato (Chopped)
  • 1 small Onion (Peeled and chopped)
  • 600 ml Water (Enough to cover the lentils)
  • 40 g Plain full-fat yogurt (Pasteurized; optional spoon on top)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Put the lentils, carrot, tomato, onion, and water in a pan.
  2. Simmer until the lentils have collapsed and the vegetables are very soft.
  3. Blend until smooth, adding a little water if it is too thick.
  4. Leave the yogurt off for a dairy-free bowl, or spoon it on after cooking.
  5. Cool to serving temperature and check there are no firm bits.

Sound idea

Salt is left out so the soup stays suitable from six months. The yogurt on top is optional and is the only source of the milk allergen.

Blend red lentils with carrot, tomato, and onion into a smooth soup. Leave the yogurt off for a dairy-free finish, or add one spoon of plain yogurt at the table. It is excellent iron and a proper meal.
